## 問題
2025 年第一季有效訂單中，使用 WELCOME10 的占比是多少？

## 回答 A
最終答案: 14.44
採用的定義與依據: 依語意層「有效訂單」定義取 orders.status IN (1,2,3)（已付款、已出貨、已送達；待付款與已取消排除），並以 order_ts 落在 2025-01-01 至 2025-03-31 篩選。在 11,901 張有效訂單中，coupon_code = 'WELCOME10' 有 1,718 張，占比為 14.44（0–100）。
SQL 1: ["SELECT coupon_code, COUNT(*) n FROM orders WHERE coupon_code LIKE '%WELCOME%' GROUP BY coupon_code", "SELECT order_ts, status, coupon_code FROM orders LIMIT 5"]
  結果: [{'query': "SELECT coupon_code, COUNT(*) n FROM orders WHERE coupon_code LIKE '%WELCOME%' GROUP BY coupon_code", 'columns': ['coupon_code', 'n'], 'rows': [['WELCOME10', 8830]], 'truncated': False}, {'query': 'SELECT order_ts, status, coupon_code FROM orders LIMIT 5', 'columns': ['order_ts', 'status'
SQL 2: SELECT COUNT(*) AS valid_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN coupon_code = 'WELCOME10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS welcome10_orders, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN coupon_code = 'WELCOME10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS welcome10_pct FROM orders WHERE status IN (1, 2, 3) AND order_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND order_ts < '2025-04-01'
  結果: {'columns': ['valid_orders', 'welcome10_orders', 'welcome10_pct'], 'rows': [[11901, 1718, 14.44]], 'truncated': False}

## 回答 B
最終答案: 14.44
採用的定義與依據: 依語意層定義，有效訂單為 orders.status 為 1（已付款）、2（已出貨）、3（已送達）的訂單，並以不重複 order_id 計張數。以 order_ts 篩選 2025-01-01 至 2025-03-31，有效訂單共 11,901 張，其中 coupon_code = 'WELCOME10' 的有 1,718 張，占比 14.44%。
SQL 1: ["SELECT coupon_code, COUNT(*) n FROM orders GROUP BY coupon_code ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 50", "SELECT order_ts FROM orders ORDER BY order_ts LIMIT 5"]
  結果: [{'query': 'SELECT coupon_code, COUNT(*) n FROM orders GROUP BY coupon_code ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 50', 'columns': ['coupon_code', 'n'], 'rows': [[None, 41966], ['SUMMER15', 9204], ['WELCOME10', 8830]], 'truncated': False}, {'query': 'SELECT order_ts FROM orders ORDER BY order_ts LIMIT 5', 'columns':
SQL 2: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS valid_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN coupon_code = 'WELCOME10' THEN order_id END) AS welcome10_orders, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN coupon_code = 'WELCOME10' THEN order_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS welcome10_pct FROM orders WHERE status IN (1, 2, 3) AND order_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND order_ts < '2025-04-01'
  結果: {'columns': ['valid_orders', 'welcome10_orders', 'welcome10_pct'], 'rows': [[11901, 1718, 14.44]], 'truncated': False}

response: {"winner": "B", "reason": "兩者採用相同的有效訂單定義與時間篩選，得到相同結果（11,901 張中 1,718 張，占 14.44%）；B 以 COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) 計張數，能防範重複列，探索查詢也檢視了全部優惠碼分布，因此略為穩健。", "critical_error": false}
